title: The end-of-turn check is on by default: once per turn it asks the agent to record guesses after code changes
why: Agents forget to record without a nudge; the cost is one short extra reply on editing turns
alternatives: Off by default, users opt in

resolution.decision: The end-of-turn check is on by default: once per turn it asks the agent to record guesses after code changes
resolution.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). Reliable recording is the core promise; the cost is one short reply on editing turns, and config can relax it.
